Neon Marble Run

Physics-based marble obstacle course utilizing Semi-Implicit Euler integration, SAT collisions, and real-time PBR lighting. Featuring generative AI textures and dynamic generative audio synths triggered by impact impulses.

Use W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys to apply torque to the marble. Don't fall off.
